INTRODUCTION
Antenatal corticosteroid (ACS) therapy is one of the most cost-effective
interventions for improving outcomes of preterm birth. When given to women with
a high likelihood of preterm birth, it reduces neonatal mortality, incidence and
severity of respiratory distress syndrome, and intraventricular haemorrhage

title: ACS Eligibility Criteria
example_questions: What are the eligibility criteria for ACS?

text:
GIVE ACS WHEN ALL CONDITIONS ARE MET IN WOMEN AT 24+0 TO
33+6 WEEKS OF GESTATION:
1. High likelihood of preterm birth within the next 7 days due to any one:
Spontaneous preterm labour: regular contractions with cervical change
consider (dilatation or effacement)
PPROM without clinical infection
Antepartum Hemorrhage
Severe pre-eclampsia/eclampsia
Planned preterm birth for maternal/fetal indication
2. Gestational age assessed accurately, preferably by early USG
